narrative_engine.thesis: trend down context (H4 stack down · D1 stack down · EMA spread -5.42 ATR · price holds below Day VWAP) set the SHORT bias. Price pulled back into the confluence zone 1602.38-1618.20 (VWAP band · POC · EMA pocket · PDH/PDL flip) — the trigger is still pending. Risk is defined beyond 1627.00; the first objective pays 0.28R at 1597.98.

plan.triggerRule: await bearish footprint confirmation (absorption / strong divergence / trap) or wall+CVD confluence at 1602.38-1618.20
plan.invalidation: structure beyond 1627.00 (signal zone / ±2σ VWAP / 0.5 ATR buffer)
vetoes: M1 R 0.28 < 1.5 — reward does not pay the risk

athena_oracle.verdict: Cautious bearish lean 32/100 — trend broken, ask-wall ceiling

basis.coinbaseReason: Coinbase premium tracked for BTC/ETH/SOL only

funding rates are percent per interval; annualizedAprPct = oiWeightedRate8h(%) x 3 x 365
fundingImpliedAprPct is the funding-implied carry (oiWeightedRate8h annualized) — NOT a basis APR
